name: browseros-neo
description: BrowserOS neo — a second browser for AI agents. Chromium fork with one-click Chrome login import, live dashboard, and scrubbable session replay. MCP browser tools via http://127.0.0.1:9010/mcp.

browseros-neo.instructions:
Drive the user's BrowserOS neo browser (a separate Chromium browser for agents) through its local MCP endpoint. Use this for pages that need a real logged-in session, anti-bot handling, or session recording — the browser inherits the user's Chrome logins (imported once at BrowserOS neo setup).

Real tool surface (verified on browseros-neo v0.0.28):
- tabs (list / active / new / close), navigate ({page, action: url|back|forward|reload}), windows (list / create / close)
- read ({page, format: text|markdown|links|console}), grep, snapshot, diff
- act (click / type / press key …), evaluate ({page, code}), run, wait
- screenshot, pdf, download, upload
- history, tab_groups, name_session

Practical notes:
- Agent-owned pages must be created with `tabs` action="new" (returns "opened page N"); the agent cannot navigate pages it does not own.
- Prefer `evaluate` returning document.body.innerText over `read` for price/data extraction; `read` can return empty on JS-heavy pages.
- BrowserOS neo must be running on this machine (its MCP endpoint listens on 127.0.0.1:9010). If the connection is refused, ask the user to launch BrowserOS neo. Override the URL with env SATI_BROWSEROS_MCP_URL when the port differs.
- The endpoint has no authentication — any process on this machine can control the browser. Only enable on a trusted machine.
- Every agent session is recorded and replayable from the BrowserOS neo dashboard; screenshots/saved files are returned as tool results.
- Under heavy tab churn the browser window/profile can become unavailable ("No browser window available") — restart the BrowserOS neo app to recover.
